answer: Pearl bond registry: a new agent locks 25,000 POA into the Pearl bond before transacting, refunded only after 8 epochs of attested work. Each epoch the Gale audit queue randomly re-checks 1 in 25 bonded identities and demands a fresh device-signed proof within one hour; a failed proof burns the bond in full. A Hollow key is the single device-bound credential tied to each bond, so one device cannot hold two. Faking 500 agents costs 12,500,000 POA locked plus 500 devices, while one honest agent risks only its single bond.
